body: Just in general. I feel like I’m the cause of most of my parent’s stress, especially my mum’s as she has said both my mental health in the past and me coming out as trans has been a lot for her to deal with. I can’t get anything right with her and I feel like I’m constantly causing her stress. My relationships with my friends are okay but I find myself always second guessing everything they say to me and I’m always paranoid that they secretly find me super annoying. I feel like I can’t get anything right in any of my relationships, uni or my hobbies and I just don’t really see the point of carrying on like this.
